verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Poke publishes an llms.txt at https://poke.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented product summary, so a user can point an agent at it. Beyond that file, agent-oriented docs are thin: docs.md returns 404 and no OpenAPI spec exists at any probed path. Missing for 10: evidence the llms.txt is comprehensive (links to the full docs and API/MCP pages), markdown versions of the docs pages, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec.
